blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal encoders such as CLIP underlie many downstream systems, but their web-scale training data embed harmful associations that safety alignment must suppress without unnecessarily changing benign representations. Because ethical and practical constraints prevent collecting real unsafe content at scale, existing datasets pair safe real samples with generated counterparts, but label every generated sample unsafe, even when one modality is individually safe. To address this, we introduce ShieldCLIP, the first framework to condition safety alignment on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, preserving safe content while redirecting only what is unsafe. We also introduce ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent per-modality safety labels across 578 concepts and 28 categories. Using these labels, ShieldCLIP defines a four-way conditional objective beyond pair-level supervision: safe content is anchored, unsafe modalities are redirected to their safe counterparts, mixed pairs update only the unsafe branch, and coherence is enforced when both are unsafe. We evaluate ShieldCLIP on cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Across these settings, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs over prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines, while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Extensive ablation studies further show that both modality-specific supervision and the selective alignment objective contribute to these gains. Source code, trained models, and ViSUv2 (under a controlled-access protocol) will be made publicly available at https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/ .
blocks.zh: 多式联运编码器,如CLIP,是许多下游系统的基础,但其网络规模的培训数据嵌入了有害的关联,安全协调必须加以抑制,而不会不必要地改变良性表述。 由于道德和实际限制阻碍大规模收集真正的不安全内容,现有的数据集将安全真实的样本与生成的对应物配对,但给每个生成的样本贴上不安全的标签,即使一种模式单独是安全的. 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了ShieldCLIP,这是第一个将安全调整以每种模式的观测到的安全状态作为条件的框架,而不是样本的来源,保护安全内容,而只改变不安全的内容。 我们还引入了VisUv2,一个195k-quadruplet数据集,它具有578个概念和28个类别的独立的单式安全标签。 使用这些标签,ShieldCLIP定义了一个超出对等级监督的四向条件目标:安全内容是锚定的,不安全模式被重定向到安全对应方,混合配对只更新不安全分支,在两者都不安全时执行一致性. 我们评价了ShieldCLIP的跨模式检索、文本到图像的生成和稳定扩散v1.4和SDXL,以及图像到文本的生成和LLaVA。 通过这些设置,ShieldCLIP在保持原始嵌入空间的效用的同时,始终比先前的安全编码器和强大的缓解基线减少有害的输出。 广泛的弃权研究进一步表明,特定模式的监督以及选择性的调整目标都有助于取得这些成果。 源代码、训练有素的模型和VISUv2(根据控制存取协议)将在https://aimagelab.github.io/ShieldCLIP/上公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Podell et al., 2024 ) , and FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) , have enabled rich cross-modal associations between images and text, powering applications from retrieval and captioning to large-scale generative systems. These models derive their generalization abilities from massive web-scale datasets, but uncontrolled data collection can introduce harmful biases ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) , unsafe associations ( Abid et al., 2021 ) , and inappropriate content ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) . Their outputs can consequently drift into sexual, violent, or otherwise harmful content, raising serious concerns about responsible deployment ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ; Weidinger et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: CLIP(Radford等人,2021年),LLAVA(Liu等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年a),稳定扩散(Rombach等人,2022年;Esser等人,2024年;Podell等人,2024年)和FLUX(Black Forest Labs,2024年)等多模式基础模型的近期进展,使图像和文本之间能够建立丰富的跨模式联系,使应用从检索和字幕到大型分系系统。 这些模型从庞大的网络尺度数据集中获取其概括化能力,但不加控制的数据收集可能引入有害的偏见(Birhane等人,2021年),不安全的关联(Abid等人,2021年),以及不适当的内容(Schuhmann等人,2022年). 因此,它们的输出物可能会流入性、暴力或其他有害的内容,引起人们对负责任的部署的严重关切(Bommasani等人,2021年;Weidinger等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: A central challenge lies in the shared embedding space learned by models such as CLIP. This space supports multimodal retrieval ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) , text-to-image generation ( Podell et al., 2024 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) , and visual dialog and reasoning ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . Unsafe prompts or images can be projected into harmful regions of this space, steering downstream pipelines toward inappropriate outputs. Conversely, benign prompts can yield unsafe generations because of biases in learned associations ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) . Improving safety at the encoder level can therefore benefit several downstream systems without modifying each decoder independently.
blocks.zh: 中心挑战在于CLIP等模型所学到的共享嵌入空间. 此空间支持多模式检索(Wang等人,2024;Wei等人,2024),文本到图像生成. (Podell等人,2024年;Rombach等人,2022年),和视觉对话和推理(刘等人,2023年;刘等人,2024年a). 不安全的提示或图像可以投射到这一空间的有害区域,引导下游管道向不适当的产出方向发展。 反之,良性诱因可能会产生不安全的几代人,因为有学识的协会存在偏见(Schramowski等人,2023年)。 因此,提高编码器的安全性可以使几个下游系统受益,而无需独立修改每个解码器。

blocks.en: Embedding-level mitigation offers a general way to intervene before decoding ( Kim and Qi, 2025 ) : unsafe inputs are redirected toward benign representations, while safe content is anchored to the original embedding space ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Poppi et al., 2024 ; Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) . Recent work extends this line by restructuring the shared space itself ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) or by bounding how far unsafe concepts are displaced ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) . The concern motivating both is that aggressive redirection collapses the semantic structure of the space and erodes utility in ways that standard metrics do not expose ( Yousaf et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 嵌入级缓解提供了一个在解码前进行干预的一般方法(Kim and Qi, 2025年):不安全的投入被重新导向良性表达,而安全内容则被固定在原始嵌入空间上(Liu等人, 2024b; Poppi等人, 2024年; Ahn and Jung, 2025年)。 最近的工作通过调整共享空间本身(Poppi等人,2025年)或限定不安全概念被取代的程度(Yousaf等人,2026a年)来扩展这一界限。 两者的动因都在于,主动的重定向使空间的语义结构崩溃,并以标准衡量标准不暴露的方式侵蚀效用(Yousaf等人,2026b)。

blocks.en: How supervision is obtained compounds this risk. Because real unsafe images and captions cannot be collected at scale for ethical and practical reasons, existing paired-data formulations synthesize them instead: a safe caption is rewritten into an unsafe variant conditioned on a harmful concept, and an image is generated from that unsafe caption. The resulting pair is then treated as jointly unsafe simply because it was produced by this pipeline, even though neither rewriting a caption around a harmful concept nor rendering an image from it guarantees that the output is actually harmful: a caption about fraud may produce a visually harmless office scene, while a benign caption about an operating room may yield disturbing surgical imagery. Such cases are not marginal. In the data we collect, 39% of generated pairs combine a safe modality with an unsafe one, so uniform redirection alters benign representations and introduces conflicting supervision whenever the two modalities disagree.
blocks.zh: 如何获得监督会增加这种风险。 由于出于伦理和实际原因,无法大规模收集真正的不安全图像和字幕,因此现有的配对数据配方将其合成:一个安全字幕被重写成一个以有害概念为条件的不安全变体,一个图像由这个不安全字幕产生。 由此产生的配对被简单地视为共同不安全,因为它是由这一管道生产的,尽管既没有围绕一个有害的概念改写一个字幕,也没有从中制作一个图像,可以保证产出实际上有害:关于欺诈的字幕可能会产生一个视觉无害的办公场景,而关于手术室的良性字幕可能会产生令人不安的外科图像。 这些案件并非微不足道。 在我们收集的数据中,39%的生成对子结合了安全模式和不安全模式,所以当两种模式有分歧时,统一的重定向会改变良性表述,引入相互矛盾的监督.

blocks.en: To address this problem, we introduce ShieldCLIP , a framework for selective safety alignment in CLIP-like multimodal encoders. It is trained on data that preserve the semantic correspondence between real and generated image-text pairs while carrying an independent safety label for each generated modality. The resulting formulation distinguishes safe-safe, unsafe-unsafe, safe-text/unsafe-image, and unsafe-text/safe-image pairs, allowing supervision to follow the observed content rather than its source.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了ShieldCLIP,一种在类似CLIP的多式联运编码器中进行选择性安全调整的框架. 培训内容是数据,既能保留真实的和生成的图像文本对之间的语义对应,又能为每个生成模式带一个独立的安全标签。 由此产生的配方区分了安全无虞,不安全无虞,安全文字/不安全形象,以及不安全无虞文字/不安全形象的配对,允许监督跟踪所观察到的内容而不是其来源.

blocks.en: We further introduce ViSUv2 , a dataset of 195k real/generated image-text quadruplets. ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) pairs safe image-text samples with generated counterparts under a common safety assignment and a 20-category taxonomy. ViSUv2 retains this paired structure while labeling generated captions and images independently, expanding the taxonomy to 28 categories grounded in 578 fine-grained concepts, and using more recent language and diffusion models.
blocks.zh: 由195k真实/生成的图像文本四重奏组成的数据集。 ViSU(Poppi等人,2024年)根据共同的安全任务和20类分类法,与生成的对应物对映安全图像文本样本。 ViSUv2保留了这种配对结构,同时独立标记生成的字幕和图像,将分类学扩展到28个基于578个精细纹理概念的类别,并使用较新的语言和传播模型.

blocks.en: These modality-level labels enable a conditional objective that pair-level alignment, which redirects all generated content under a shared safety assignment, cannot express. Real and generated-safe samples are preserved by aligning them with frozen CLIP anchors, while generated-unsafe samples are redirected toward their real safe counterparts. For mixed pairs, only the unsafe modality is updated while the safe branch is frozen; when both generated modalities are unsafe, an additional coherence term preserves their semantic correspondence during redirection. This selective design reduces over-sanitization while maintaining compatibility with systems built on the original CLIP geometry.
blocks.zh: 这些模式级标签能够使对等级对齐的有条件目标在共享安全任务下重新定向所有生成的内容,无法表达. 真实的和产生安全样品通过与冷冻的CLIP锚地对齐来保存,而生成的安全样品则被重定向到真正的安全样品上。 对于混合配对,在安全分支被冻结时,只更新不安全模式;当两个生成的模式都不安全时,一个额外的一致性术语在重定向时保留了它们的语义通信. 这种选择性设计在保持与基于原始CLIP几何学的系统兼容性的同时,降低了过密性.

blocks.en: We first validate ViSUv2 against existing safety datasets in terms of diversity and harmfulness. We then evaluate ShieldCLIP across cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA. Beyond the main comparisons, we assess robustness across prompt distributions and different safety classifiers, study the contribution of modality-specific supervision and individual loss components, and analyze the safety–utility trade-off through retrieval, generation, and preservation metrics. Automatic evaluation is further complemented by human judgments of safety and content preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据现有的安全数据集对VISUv2进行多样性和有害性的验证。 然后我们通过跨模式检索评价ShieldCLIP,用稳定扩散 v1.4 和 SDXL 生成文本,用LLaVA生成图像到文本。 除了主要比较之外,我们评估快速分发和不同安全分类的稳健性,研究特定模式的监督和个人损失成分的贡献,并通过检索、生成和保全指标分析安全实用性权衡。 人类对安全和内容保存的判断进一步补充了自动评价。

blocks.en: Contributions. Our main contributions are: • Data and supervision. We introduce ViSUv2, with independent text and image safety labels, 578 concepts, 28 categories, and human validation of the modality-level annotations. • Selective alignment. We condition preservation and redirection on modality-specific safety states, explicitly handling mixed pairs and maintaining coherence when both modalities are unsafe. • Evaluation. We evaluate ShieldCLIP across cross-modal retrieval, diffusion models, and multimodal language models, complemented by evaluation with multiple safety classifiers, human judgments, targeted ablation studies of the selective objective, and preservation analyses.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 我们的主要贡献是:数据和监督。 我们引入了VisUv2,并有独立的文字和图像安全标签,578个概念,28个类别,以及人类验证模式级说明. • 选择性调整。 我们以特定方式的安全状态作为保存和改变方向的条件,明确处理混合配对,并在两种方式不安全时保持一致性。 • 评价。 我们通过跨模式检索、传播模式和多模式语言模式对ShieldCLIP进行评估,并辅之以多种安全分类、人文判断、选择性目标的定点消化研究以及保存分析。

blocks.en: Data and supervision. We introduce ViSUv2, with independent text and image safety labels, 578 concepts, 28 categories, and human validation of the modality-level annotations.
blocks.zh: 数据和监督。 我们引入了VisUv2,并有独立的文字和图像安全标签,578个概念,28个类别,以及人类验证模式级说明.

blocks.en: Selective alignment. We condition preservation and redirection on modality-specific safety states, explicitly handling mixed pairs and maintaining coherence when both modalities are unsafe.
blocks.zh: 选择性对齐. 我们以特定方式的安全状态作为保存和改变方向的条件,明确处理混合配对,并在两种方式不安全时保持一致性。

blocks.en: Evaluation. We evaluate ShieldCLIP across cross-modal retrieval, diffusion models, and multimodal language models, complemented by evaluation with multiple safety classifiers, human judgments, targeted ablation studies of the selective objective, and preservation analyses.
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们通过跨模式检索、传播模式和多模式语言模式对ShieldCLIP进行评估,并辅之以多种安全分类、人文判断、选择性目标的定点消化研究以及保存分析。

blocks.en: Relation to the Conference Version. This work extends Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , which addressed encoder-level mitigation through pair-level supervision that treated all generated samples as unsafe. Here, we formulate safety alignment at the modality level and condition the objective on the four possible safety states of generated image-text pairs. We replace ViSU with ViSUv2, which introduces independent text and image safety labels, expands the taxonomy from 20 to 28 categories, and includes human validation of the annotations. To disentangle the contribution of the new data from that of the selective objective, we conduct matched training experiments with Safe-CLIP and ShieldCLIP on both ViSU and ViSUv2. We further extend the experimental analysis with targeted ablation studies of modality-specific supervision and loss design, evaluation with SDXL and multiple safety classifiers, and a human preference study.
blocks.zh: 与会议版本的关系. 这项工作延伸了Safe-CLIP(Poppi等人,2024年),通过将所有生成的样品视为不安全的对等监督,解决了编码器水平的缓解问题. 在此,我们在模式层面制定安全配对,并以生成的图像文本对的四个可能的安全状态作为目标的条件。 我们用ViSUv2取代ViSU,它引入了独立的文本和图像安全标签,将分类学从20类扩展至28类,并包括了人类验证说明. 为了区分新数据与选择性目标的贡献,我们在VISU和VISUv2上与Safe-CLIP和ShieldCLIP进行了匹配的培训实验。 我们进一步扩大试验分析,对特定模式的监督和损失设计进行有针对性的消减研究,对SDXL和多个安全分类器进行评价,并开展一项人类偏好研究。

blocks.en: The rest of the paper is organized as follows. Section 2 reviews related work on safety alignment. Section 3.1 formalizes safety alignment in multimodal encoders, and Sections 3.2 and 3.3 introduce ViSUv2 and the ShieldCLIP framework, respectively. Section 4 presents the experimental evaluation and analyses. Additional dataset details, extended results, and qualitative examples are provided in the appendices.
blocks.zh: 本文其余部分编排如下. 第2节审查有关安全协调的工作。 第3.1节正式确定多式联运编码器的安全统一,第3.2和3.3节分别引入了VISUv2和ShieldCLIP框架。 第4节介绍试验性评价和分析。 附录提供了其他数据集细节、扩展成果和定性实例。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Harmful Content Mitigation Techniques
blocks.zh: 2.1 有害内容缓解技术

blocks.en: Approaches to mitigating harmful content in text-to-image diffusion models can be categorized by their intervention stage: decoding-time methods, which act during image generation, and pre-decoding methods, which operate on latent or embedding representations beforehand.
blocks.zh: 减轻文字到图像传播模型中有害内容的方法可按其干预阶段分类:在图像生成期间起作用的解码时间方法,以及事先在潜在或嵌入表示上起作用的解码前方法。

blocks.en: Decoding-Time Methods. These techniques directly regulate the diffusion process to prevent unsafe visual concepts from emerging. Model-editing approaches modify the generative parameters to erase undesired concepts, either by fine-tuning the U-Net ( Kumari et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) or by refining cross-attention layers for localized, scalable concept removal ( Gandikota et al., 2023 ; Gandikota et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . More recent work addresses the residual weaknesses of this family: the entanglement between an erased concept and its semantic neighbors ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , the imprecision of purely text-side supervision ( Li et al., 2026 ; Vardhana and Biswas, 2026 ) , and the recovery of erased concepts under adversarial prompting ( Tsai et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . While effective, these methods can over-suppress related but benign concepts and typically require retraining or separate fine-tuning for each new concept to be removed, limiting scalability. Inference-guidance techniques instead steer sampling without altering model weights, using latent-space directions ( Li et al., 2024a ) or classifier-free guidance mechanisms ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) to avoid unsafe activations. They are lightweight and reversible but often less robust to ambiguous prompts and limited in controllability. In contrast to these generator-specific interventions, we operate upstream of the diffusion process by aligning the encoder that conditions generation. The resulting encoder can therefore be reused across compatible downstream systems that rely on the same CLIP backbone, without modifying their decoders.
blocks.zh: 解码-时间方法. 这些技术直接调节传播过程,以防止不安全的视觉概念出现. 模型编辑方法修改了基因参数,以删除不受欢迎的概念,方法有的是通过微调U-Net(Kumari等人,2023年;Li等人,2024年b;Kim等人,2024年;Lyu等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年),有的则通过提炼用于本地化、可扩展概念清除的交叉观察层(Gandikota等人,2023年;Gandikota等人,2024年;Lu等人,2024年;黄等人,2024年;范等人,2024年). 最近的工作解决了这个家族的剩余弱点:一个被抹去的概念与其语义邻居之间的纠缠(Shi等人,2026年),纯文本侧监督的不准确(Li等人,2026年;Vardhana和Biswas,2026年),以及在对抗诱导下被抹去的概念的恢复(Tsai等人,2024年;Yin等人,2025年)。 这些方法虽然有效,但可以过度压抑相关但良性的概念,通常需要再培训或对每个新概念进行单独的微调,从而限制可扩展性。 推论指导技术在不改变模型重量的情况下,利用潜在的空间方向指导取样 (Li等人,2024a)或分类无危险引导机制(Schramowski等人,2023年)以避免不安全的激活. 它们是轻量级和可逆的,但往往不太强壮,难以确定诱因,而且控制力有限。 与这些针对生成器的干预措施形成对比的是,我们在扩散过程的上游运作,将生成条件的编码器对齐。 因此,由此产生的编码器可以在依赖同一CLIP主干线的兼容下游系统中重复使用,而不修改其解码器.

blocks.en: Pre-Decoding Methods. These methods intervene before image generation by sanitizing or aligning latent embeddings. For example, Latent Guard ( Liu et al., 2024b ) filters harmful text representations, while Embedding Sanitizer ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) improves robustness through optimization or preference learning, and DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) and SafeText ( Hu et al., 2025b ) fine-tune the text encoder so that unsafe prompts are displaced while safe ones remain in place. PromptGuard ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) instead prepends a learned soft prompt, moderating unsafe generations without updating model weights. In our previous work, Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we extended this idea to multimodal encoders, aligning safe and unsafe image-text pairs to weaken unsafe associations.
blocks.zh: 释前法. 这些方法在图像生成之前通过对潜在嵌入物进行消毒或对齐而进行干预. 例如,Latent Guard(Liu等人,2024b)过滤有害的文本表达,而Embedding Sanitizer(Quu等人,2024年)则通过优化或偏好学习提高稳健性,DES(Ahn and Jung,2025年)和SafeText(SafeText,2025b年)则对文本编码器进行微调,使不安全的提示被取代,同时安全提示仍然到位. PowerGuard(Yuan等人,2026年)相反,在不更新模型权重的情况下,预示着学习到的软速率,缓和不安全的几代人. 在我们之前的作品Safe-CLIP(Poppi等人,2024年)中,我们把这个想法推广到多式联运编码器,将安全和不安全的图像文本对齐以削弱不安全的联系.

blocks.en: Two recent works refine this encoder-level formulation. HySAC ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) abandons the flat embedding geometry, organizing safe and unsafe content in a hyperbolic hierarchy that queries can traverse toward safe regions, while SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) keeps each unsafe concept close to its nearest safe alternative, recovering zero-shot accuracy lost to more aggressive redirection. Both govern where unsafe content is sent. ShieldCLIP retains this pre-decoding, encoder-level formulation but instead governs what is redirected: generated items are labeled separately by modality, preservation is applied to generated-safe content, and redirection is restricted to the modalities labeled unsafe. Differently from our previous version, which assigns a single safety state to each generated pair, supervision here follows the observed content of each modality rather than its origin.
blocks.zh: 最近的两项著作完善了这种编码器级的配体. HySAC(Poppi等人,2025年)放弃了平面嵌入几何结构,将安全和不安全的内容组织在一个双曲结构中,询问可以向安全区域过渡,而SafeR-CLIP(Yousaf等人,2026a年)则使每一个不安全的概念都接近其最近的安全选择,恢复零射精度损失到更积极的重定向. 两者都管辖发送不安全内容的地方。 ShieldCLIP保留了这种预解码,编码器级的配方,而是规范了重定向的:生成的物项按模式分别标注,保存适用于生成安全内容,重定向仅限于标注不安全的模式. 不同于我们以前的版本,它给每个生成的对子分配一个单一的安全状态,这里的监督遵循的是每种模式的观测内容而不是其起源.

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets for Harmful Content Mitigation
blocks.zh: 2.2 减少有害内容数据集

blocks.en:
Existing datasets for harmful content mitigation mainly focus on text-only benchmarks or prompt-based red-teaming, offering limited multimodal coverage and weak safe-unsafe correspondence.
I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) collects 4.7k real-world web prompts using NSFW-related keywords to evaluate unsafe generations, while SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) provides ∼ \sim 200 jailbreak prompts crafted with ChatGPT to elicit explicit content. Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) extends this line with subsets of NSFW, safe, and inverse prompts targeting nudity and violence, though many prompts are syntactically noisy and narrow. Similarly, MMA-Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2024a ) introduces explicit NSFW prompts along with adversarial, sanitized, and safe variants, but lacks one-to-one safe-unsafe pairing and contains many ungrammatical prompts. CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) instead offers structured textual pairs from 578 harmful concepts and their benign replacements, yet remains text-only and limited in size.
blocks.zh:
减少有害内容的现有数据集主要侧重于文本专用基准或即时红调,提供有限的多式联运覆盖面和安全-不安全通信。
I2P(Schramowski等人,2023年)收集. 4.7k真实世界的网络提示使用与NSFW相关的关键词来评价不安全的几代人,而SneakyPrompt(Yang等人,2024b)则提供\sim 200的越狱提示与ChatGPT一起设计,以获取明确的内容. Ring-A-Bell(Tsai et al., 2024)将这条线延伸至NSFW的子集,安全,反向的提示针对裸体和暴力,尽管许多提示在战术上是吵闹和狭义的. 同样,MMA-Difusion(Yang等人,2024a)引入了明显的NSFW提示以及对抗,消毒,和安全的变体,但缺乏一对一的安全-不安全的配对,包含许多不语法提示. CoPro(Liu等人,2024年b)则提供578个有害概念的结构化文本配对及其良性替换,然而仍然只保留文本,且尺寸有限.

blocks.en: A second group assembles multimodal material. ToViLaG ( Wang et al., 2023 ) collects toxic image-text pairs, MM-SafetyBench ( Liu et al., 2024c ) and VLSBench ( Hu et al., 2025a ) probe multimodal language models with paired visual and textual queries, and UnsafeBench ( Qu et al., 2025 ) evaluates image safety classifiers on both real and generated images. Closer to our setting, CoProV2 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) scales concept-level prompts into preference data for alignment, and NSFW-Caps ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) contributes 1k aligned image-text pairs for measuring safety under distributional shift.
blocks.zh: 第二组收集多式联运材料。 ToViLaG(Wang等人,2023年)收集有毒的图像文本对联,MM-Safety Bench(Liu等人,2024年c)和VLS Bench(Hu等人,2025年a)探测带有对映视觉和文字查询的多模式语言模型,以及Unsafe Bench(Qu等人,2025年)对真实和生成的图像进行图像安全分类评价. CoProV2(Liu等人,2025年) 缩放概念级提示为对齐的偏好数据,而NSFW-Caps(Yousaf等人,2026a年)则贡献了1千对对对齐的图像文本,用于测量分配转移下的安全性。

blocks.en: While these datasets enable concept-level safety evaluation, they carry a single safety label per sample or prompt, and none offers aligned multimodal pairs with modality-specific annotations. ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) partially bridges this gap by pairing safe image-text samples with generated counterparts, but it treats all generated data as unsafe and uses a 20-category taxonomy. In contrast to all these resources, ViSUv2 preserves the paired real-generated design of ViSU while annotating each generated modality independently, over a taxonomy expanded to 28 categories and with more recent generators. This is the annotation that makes selective, modality-aware optimization possible in the first place.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些数据集能够进行概念层面的安全评价,但它们每个样本或即时都带有单一的安全标签,而且没有提供符合特定模式说明的多式联运对。 ViSU(Poppi等人,2024年)通过将安全的图像文本样本与生成的对应物对齐,部分弥合了这一差距,但它将所有生成的数据视为不安全,并使用20类分类法. 与所有这些资源相比,ViSUv2保留了ViSU的配对实际生成的设计,同时独立地对每个生成模式进行注释,在分类学上扩展至28个类别,并拥有更近的生成器. 这种注解使得选择性,模式意识的优化在一开始是可能的.

blocks.en: 3.1 Safety Alignment in Multimodal Encoders
blocks.zh: 3.1 多式联运编码器的安全统一

blocks.en: Scope. We study safety alignment for CLIP-like multimodal encoders, used as core components for retrieval, captioning, and text-to-image generation pipelines. Our objective is twofold: (i) suppress harmful signals in text and images and (ii) preserve benign semantics so that downstream systems relying on the original CLIP features remain compatible. Because a closed definition of “safety” is infeasible, we operate, like prior work ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Poppi et al., 2024 ; Poppi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Gandikota et al., 2023 ) , over a taxonomy of concept proxies.
blocks.zh: 范围。 我们研究类似CLIP的多式联运编码器的安全协调,用作检索、标题和文本到图像生成管道的核心组件。 我们的目标是双重的:(一) 压制文字和图像中的有害信号;(二) 保持良性语义,使依赖原始CLIP特性的下游系统保持兼容。 由于封闭的“安全”定义不可行,我们像以前的工作(Schramowski等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年b;Poppi等人,2024年;Poppi等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年;Gandikota等人,2023年)一样,在概念代词分类上运作。

blocks.en: Overview. ViSUv2 extends the paired-data construction introduced with ViSU, in which each real image-caption pair has a semantically corresponding generated pair ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , as illustrated in Fig. 1 . It adds independent safety labels for text and image, since either generated modality may be safe or unsafe. Real pairs ℛ \mathcal{R} are safe by construction, while generated pairs 𝒢 \mathcal{G} may be safe or unsafe per modality. Formally, 𝒟 = { ( v i , t i ) ∈ ℛ , ( v ¯ i [ f i v ] , t ¯ i [ f i t ] ) ∈ 𝒢 } i = 1 N , \mathcal{D}=\Big\{(v_{i},t_{i})\in\mathcal{R},\ \big(\bar{v}_{i}^{[f_{i}^{v}]},\bar{t}_{i}^{[f_{i}^{t}]}\big)\in\mathcal{G}\Big\}_{i=1}^{N}, (2) where f i v , f i t ∈ { 0 , 1 } f_{i}^{v},f_{i}^{t}\in\{0,1\} denote safe ( 0 ) (0) or unsafe ( 1 ) (1) labels. For each index i i , the generated pair ( v ¯ i , t ¯ i ) \big(\bar{v}_{i},\bar{t}_{i}\big) is constructed to describe the same underlying scene/entity/action as ( v i , t i ) (v_{i},t_{i}) . This captures mixed cases ( e.g. , generated-safe text with generated-unsafe image), as well as entirely safe and entirely unsafe generated pairs. These cases are not rare: 8.8% of the generated pairs are safe-safe, 52.3% are unsafe-unsafe, 8.4% contain safe text and an unsafe image, and 30.5% contain unsafe text and a safe image. Thus, 47.7% of the generated data would receive incorrect supervision if generation were treated as synonymous with harmfulness. blocks.en: Taxonomy. Prior safety-aligned methods typically rely on a 20-class harmful content taxonomy ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Poppi et al., 2024 ) . To better capture the diversity of unsafe content, we expand this taxonomy to 28 categories, guided by the 578 fine-grained NSFW concepts released by CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , which we use to both drive content generation and structure the taxonomy. Each concept is automatically mapped by an LLM ( i.e. , LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) ) into one or more categories, creating a many-to-many mapping that better reflects the multifaceted nature of unsafe content: for example, the concept rape is assigned to the sexual , violence , and abuse categories. Concepts thus drive sample generation, while categories enable higher-level analysis and evaluation. Further details regarding the prompt used to classify the CoPro concepts into the ViSUv2 categories are provided in Appendix 6.4 .
blocks.zh: 分类学. 先前的安全对应方法通常依赖于20级有害内容分类法(Schramowski等人,2023年;Poppi等人,2024年)。 为了更好地捕捉不安全内容的多样性,我们以CoPro(Liu et al.,2024b)发布的578个精细的NSFW概念为指导,将这种分类法扩展至28个类别,我们用来驱动内容生成和构建分类法. 每个概念由LLM自动映射(即LLaMA-3.1-8B). The concepts in B B are then clustered into 30 groups, and for each ViSU category a ∈ A a\in A , we compute the pairwise cosine distance between a a and each CoPro cluster, selecting the 8 CoPro clusters that are farthest away from the set A A – i.e. , the concepts not already represented in the original taxonomy.

blocks.en:
Text Generation. We generate captions intended to express unsafe concepts starting from safe ones by applying a corruption strategy that preserves semantic context. Specifically, given a safe caption t i t_{i} , we prompt LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) with an output prefilling attack technique ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) to rewrite it into an unsafe variant t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i} by conditioning on a sampled NSFW concept. To balance semantic relevance and coverage, we first compute CLIP similarities between t i t_{i} and the 578 candidate concepts. We retain the 50 most similar concepts and uniformly sample one to guide the rewriting. The LLM is then instructed to explicitly incorporate the sampled NSFW concept into the rewrite, ensuring that unsafe variants remain aligned with the underlying scene while differing in safety level. Each generated caption is then automatically classified as safe or unsafe using LLaMA-3.1-8B with a prefilling-based classification prompt ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) , and its underlying concept(s) are mapped to the 28 categories, enabling consistent safety labels and category-level analysis.
Further generation and classification details are reported in Appendix 6 .
blocks.zh:
文本生成. 我们通过采用保持语义背景的腐败战略,生成旨在表达从安全概念开始的不安全概念的标题。 具体地说,给一个安全的标题 t i t_{i},我们用输出预填攻击技术(Grattafiori 等人, 2024年), 将它重写成不安全的变体 t → i → bar{t}_{i} , 用一个抽样的 NSFW 概念作为条件。 为了平衡语义上的相关性和覆盖面,我们首先计算出CLIP的相似性ti t_{i}和578个候选概念. 我们保留了最相似的50个概念,并统一抽样一个来指导改写。 然后,LLM被指示将抽样的NSFW概念明确纳入重写中,确保不安全的变体与基础场景保持一致,同时安全级别不同. 然后使用LLaMA-3.1-8B自动将每个生成的字幕归类为安全或不安全,并附有一个基于预填的分类提示(Cappelletti等人,2026年),其基本概念被绘制为28个类别,从而能够进行一致的安全标签和类别级别分析。
进一步的生成和分类详情见附录6。

Image Generation. For each generated caption t ¯ i \bar{t}_{i} , we generate the corresponding image with one of two distinct text-to-image diffusion models, selected based on the caption. Specifically, we employ
NewRealityXL 1 1 1 stablediffusionapi/newrealityxl-global-nsfw , a Stable Diffusion XL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) variant fine-tuned for NSFW generation, and an uncensored variant 2 2 2 lustlyai/Flux_Lustly.ai_Uncensored_nsfw_v1 of FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) .
The two models exhibit complementary strengths: FLUX tends to generate more explicit depictions when nudity is implied, whereas SDXL produces more semantically coherent scenes for other unsafe content ( e.g. violence or suffering). To leverage this complementarity, we employ a classifier based on LLaMA-3.1-8B to predict whether the caption implies nudity. If present, the image is generated with FLUX; otherwise, with SDXL.

blocks.en: All generated images are automatically labeled as safe or unsafe by combining two complementary classifiers: NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) , which detects nudity and exposed features, and Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) , which captures broader unsafe visual cues such as violence or disturbing visual content. An image is labeled unsafe if either classifier predicts NSFW, and safe only when both agree. The classifiers are used only to assign binary modality-level safety labels during dataset construction; their scores, representations, or gradients are never used in the training objective. This procedure yields a dataset of real and generated multimodal pairs with independent safety labels for both captions and images 3 3 3 We validate the automated modality-level safety labels in a human study on 1,000 generated pairs, obtaining 86% and 81% agreement for text and image labels, respectively. Additional details are reported in Appendix 6.3 . .

blocks.en: Key Idea. ShieldCLIP conditions its training objectives on the observed safety state of each modality rather than the origin of a sample, combining preservation and redirection under modality-specific supervision. It activates these objectives conditionally to (i) preserve real samples and generated-safe samples, avoiding over-sanitization and retaining compatibility with 𝒯 0 , 𝒱 0 \mathcal{T}_{0},\mathcal{V}_{0} , and (ii) redirect generated-unsafe samples toward their safe counterparts without perturbing unrelated regions of the embedding space. Additional objectives handle mixed pairs and maintain cross-modal coherence when both generated modalities are unsafe. An overview is shown in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh: 关键思想. ShieldCLIP将其培训目标设定为每种模式的可观察到的安全状态,而不是样本的来源,在具体模式的监督下将保存和重定向结合起来。 它有条件地激活这些目标,以便(一) 保存真实样品和产生安全样品,避免过度卫生,并保持与T 0,V 0\ mathcal{T}_{0},\mathcal{V}_{0}的兼容性,以及(二) 在不扰动嵌入空间无关区域的情况下,将生成的不安全样品转向安全对应区域. 其他目标处理混合配对,并在两种生成的方式不安全时保持跨模式的一致性。 图4显示了概况。

blocks.en: Overall Training Objective. The final training objective is a weighted sum of the previously described loss functions: ℒ \displaystyle\mathcal{L} = λ real ​ ℒ pres real + λ safe ​ ℒ pres gen-safe \displaystyle=\lambda_{\text{real}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{pres}}^{\text{real}}+\lambda_{\text{safe}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{pres}}^{\text{gen-safe}} + λ redir ​ ℒ redir + λ mix ​ ℒ mix + λ coh ​ ℒ coh , \displaystyle+\lambda_{\text{redir}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{redir}}+\lambda_{\text{mix}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{mix}}+\lambda_{\text{coh}}\,\mathcal{L}_{\text{coh}}, (10) where λ \lambda parameters are used to balance the contribution of each loss component.

Overall, conditioning preservation and redirection on the observed safety state of each modality, rather than on the origin of a sample, lets ShieldCLIP treat generation and harmfulness as independent: safe content is anchored regardless of whether it is real or generated, unsafe content is redirected only where it is actually unsafe, and mixed and jointly-unsafe pairs are handled by dedicated terms instead of being collapsed into a single pair-level label. This finer-grained supervision reduces over-sanitization of benign generated content while still suppressing harmful associations, and it keeps the resulting encoders compatible with downstream systems built on the original CLIP embedding space. We evaluate these benefits next, on cross-modal retrieval and on the downstream generative systems that consume CLIP embeddings.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在每种模式的观测到的安全状态而不是样本的来源上设定保存和重定向,让ShieldCLIP将生成和有害视为独立:安全内容是固定的,无论它是真实的还是生成的,不安全内容只有在实际不安全的情况下才被重定向,混合的和联合的不安全的对用专用术语处理,而不是倒塌成单一的对级标签. 这种精细的纹理监督减少了良性生成内容的过度卫生,同时仍然抑制有害的关联,它使由此产生的编码器与基于原始CLIP嵌入空间的下游系统兼容. 我们接下来评估这些好处,即跨模式检索和消费CLIP嵌入物的下游基因系统。

blocks.en: Dataset Splits. To construct the ViSUv2 dataset, real samples are drawn from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) , two complementary datasets of natural images annotated with human-written descriptions. For each image, we randomly select one of the five available captions to reduce redundancy and avoid excessive semantic overlap across samples while maintaining linguistic variety.
blocks.zh: 数据集 Splits. 为了构建VISUv2数据集,真实样本取自COCO(Lin等人,2014年)和Flickr30k(Young等人,2014年),这两套附有人文描述的自然图像互补数据集. 对于每个图像,我们随机选择五个可用标题中的一个,以减少冗余,避免样本之间语义重叠过多,同时保持语言多样性.

blocks.en: Overall, ViSUv2 contains 195k text-image quadruplets, of which 30k are derived from Flickr30k and 165k from COCO. We use 8,000 quadruplets for testing, 8,000 for validation, and the remaining 179,000 for training. No COCO or Flickr30k image appears in more than one split.

Implementation and Training Details. We fine-tune two distinct CLIP backbone models: ViT-L-14 (corresponding to the text encoder used in Stable Diffusion v1.4) and ViT-bigG/14 (the other text encoder in Stable Diffusion XL). For parameter-efficient fine-tuning, we apply LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) to all Transformer layers of both the text and vision encoders with a rank r r equal to 16. All parameters of the original oracle encoders ( 𝒯 0 \mathcal{T}_{0} , 𝒱 0 \mathcal{V}_{0} ) remain frozen during training.
Both models are trained using the Adam optimizer with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . We train for a maximum of 50 epochs and employ early stopping based on recall, with a patience of 5 epochs. The model based on ViT-L/14 is trained on 8 A100 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 16 and no gradient accumulation, while the model based on ViT-bigG is trained on 16 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 8 and 2 gradient accumulation steps. blocks.en:
Table 1 compares ViSUv2 with existing safety datasets, including text-only resources ( i.e. , SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) , and I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) ) and multimodal ones ( i.e. , MMA-Diffusion ( Yang et al., 2024a ) and ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) ). The evaluation focuses on two key dimensions: diversity , reflecting how varied the text or images are within each dataset, and harmfulness , indicating how reliably unsafe content is captured. For text, diversity is measured with the Vendi-Score (from CLIP textual embeddings) ( Friedman and Dieng, 2023 ) , which quantifies the entropy of semantic similarities across samples, where higher values indicate greater diversity, and Self-BLEU ( Perez et al., 2022 ) , which measures sentence redundancy (lower values indicate higher diversity). Text harmfulness is estimated via LLM-based classification using GPT-3.5 Turbo ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , prompted to flag unsafe content. For images, diversity is computed using the same Vendi-Score formulation on CLIP visual embeddings, while harmfulness is evaluated through GPT-4 ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) .
Additionally, we report the proportion of harmful items detected by the classifiers used during the dataset safety labeling stage (LLaMA-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and the NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) -Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) ensemble), shown for reference to facilitate comparison across datasets. All scores are computed on items containing unsafe content, using the test splits of each dataset when available. Further details on the harmfulness and diversity evaluation protocols are provided in Appendix 7.2 .

blocks.en: Overall, ViSUv2 achieves the most balanced performance across all dimensions, combining high semantic diversity with accurate and consistent safety labeling. It attains the lowest Self-BLEU and strong Vendi-Score values across multimodal datasets, indicating diverse yet coherent unsafe captions, while exhibiting the highest proportion of harmful text. On the visual side, ViSUv2 shows the greatest image diversity and the highest level of harmfulness among generated images, consistently surpassing ViSU and MMA-Diffusion. These results show that ViSUv2 provides a rich and well-calibrated source of unsafe content while maintaining clear distinctions between safe and unsafe modalities.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,ViSUv2在各个方面都实现了最平衡的性能,将高语义多样性与准确和一致的安全标签相结合. 它在多模式数据集中实现了最低的“自负盈亏”和强的“Vendi-Score”值,显示各种但一致的不安全标题,同时显示有害文字的比例最高。 在视觉方面,VISUv2在生成的图像中表现出最大的图像多样性和最高的有害程度,持续超过VISU和MMA-Diffusion. 这些结果显示,VISUv2提供了丰富和经过精心校准的不安全内容来源,同时对安全模式和不安全模式保持明确区分.

Table 2 reports results on I2P ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , using the entire set of prompts available in the dataset, and on the NSFW subset of the ViSUv2 test split, covering a broad range of unsafe categories. For each dataset, we compute the average violation rate across categories 4 4 4 Appendix 7.1 reports the mapping from our 28 categories to the seven groups commonly used in prior work. , averaging per prompt over the five generations. blocks.en: Across both diffusion backbones and datasets, ShieldCLIP achieves the lowest average harmful generation rate. On SD v1.4, it reduces harmful generations from 38.1% to 3.5% on I2P and from 25.4% to 1.0% on ViSUv2. Compared with our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , this corresponds to a substantial reduction from 21.8% and 6.1%, respectively. ShieldCLIP also improves over the recent encoder-level SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) (16.8% and 7.5%) and strong mitigation methods such as SafetyDPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) (11.4% and 2.8%), SLD-Strong ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) (11.8% and 4.1%), and DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) (3.9% and 1.1%). The advantage becomes more pronounced with SDXL, where ShieldCLIP reaches 4.6% on I2P and 1.4% on ViSUv2, consistently improving over Safe-CLIP, SafetyDPO, and DES. Overall, these results show that selective alignment provides consistent safety gains across both datasets and diffusion backbones.

blocks.en: These gains also extend beyond the two main evaluation benchmarks. To probe robustness across different NSFW prompt distributions, Table 4.3 reports results on four additional sources: ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , SneakyPrompt ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , MMA ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , and Ring-A-Bell ( Tsai et al., 2024 ) , including adversarial and implicitly unsafe prompts designed to bypass safety mechanisms. With SDXL, ShieldCLIP achieves the best or tied-best result on three of four datasets and remains within 0.1 percentage points of the best result on ViSU, further supporting robustness across prompt distributions and diffusion backbones. blocks.en: Qualitative results in Fig. 5 further confirm this trend across both violent and sexually explicit prompts. Compared with Safe-CLIP, SafetyDPO, and SLD-Strong, ShieldCLIP more consistently suppresses harmful visual cues while preserving the main scene semantics, without substantially distorting the generated content.

blocks.en: Evaluation with an Alternative Safety Classifier. Since NudeNet and Q16 are used to assign image-level safety labels during ViSUv2 construction, we additionally evaluate all generated images with LlavaGuard ( Helff et al., 2025 ) , which is not used during dataset construction or training. Unlike the NudeNet-Q16 ensemble, LlavaGuard is a multimodal LLM-based moderation model that reasons over visual content according to a textual safety policy, providing a substantially different evaluation mechanism. This experiment therefore directly tests whether the gains of ShieldCLIP persist under a safety evaluator disjoint from the labeling pipeline.

blocks.zh: 结果扩大到表4.3中的其他迅速来源。 ShieldCLIP在每套传播主干线的四套数据集中,有三套取得了最佳或捆绑效果,而其余案例则始终保持低水平。 特别是,在SD v1.4中,在VisU、SneakyPrompt、MMA和Ring-A-Bell上,有害的几代人分别受限于0.5%、0.6%、0.1%和1.3%;在SDXL中,相应的比率保持在0.0-1.5%之间。 这种行为在显著不同的即时分布中是一致的,包括对抗性基准和红队基准.

blocks.en: Overall, LlavaGuard closely reproduces the trends observed with NudeNet-Q16 on both the main benchmarks and the additional prompt sources. Since LlavaGuard is not used for dataset labeling or training, these consistent gains show that the improvements of ShieldCLIP are not specific to the safety classifiers used to construct ViSUv2, but reflect robust reductions in harmful generation.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,LlavaGuard在主要基准和额外迅速来源上密切重复了NudeNet-Q16观察到的趋势。 由于LlavaGuard不用于数据集标签或培训,这些一致的收获表明,ShieldCLIP的改进并非专门针对用于构建Visuv2的安全分类器,而是反映了有害生成的强劲减少.

blocks.en: Human Evaluation. To complement the automated evaluation, we conduct a human preference study with 20 independent annotators. We collect 1,200 pairwise evaluations from prompts randomly sampled from the ViSUv2 test set, balanced equally across the three competing methods (400 comparisons each): Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) , and SafetyDPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Each comparison presents ShieldCLIP alongside one competitor, with method identities hidden and left/right order randomized.
blocks.zh: 人文评价. 为了补充自动评估,我们与20名独立注释员进行了人类偏好研究。 我们从从VISUv2测试集随机抽样的提示中收集1 200个双向评价,在三种相互竞争的方法(每个比较400个)之间平衡:Safe-CLIP (Poppi等人,2024年),SafeR-CLIP (Yousaf等人,2026a),以及SafetyDPO。 (刘等,2025). 每次比较都显示ShieldCLIP与一个竞争对手并列,方法身份隐藏,左/右顺序随机排列.

blocks.en: Annotators evaluate each pair according to two criteria: safety , indicating which image better avoids harmful or inappropriate content, and content preservation , indicating which image better preserves the semantics of the original prompt while remaining safe. For each criterion, annotators can prefer either image or indicate a tie when neither output is clearly preferred. To obtain a single preference score for each method, ties are split equally between the two models. Table 4.3 reports the resulting percentage of preference assigned to each competitor over ShieldCLIP. Across all three comparisons, ShieldCLIP is preferred by a clear majority for both criteria. These results complement the automated evaluation, confirming that our method produces outputs that are both safer and more faithful to the original prompts compared to existing approaches.
blocks.zh: 注释者按照两个标准对每对进行评价:安全性,说明哪个图像更好地避免有害或不适当的内容,以及内容保存 ,说明哪个图像在保持安全的同时更好地保存原始提示的语义. 对于每一项标准,当两种输出都明显偏好时,注释者可以选择图像或表示平局. 为了获得每种方法的单一偏好分数,在两种模式之间平分关系. 表4.3报告了因此给每个竞争者以比ShieldCLIP优惠的百分比。 在所有三种比较中,ShieldCLIP在两种标准中都得到明显多数的青睐。 这些结果补充了自动化评价,证实我们的方法所产生的产出与现有方法相比既安全又更忠实于最初的提示。

blocks.en: 4.4 Image-to-Text Generation Results
blocks.zh: 4.4 图像到文本生成结果

blocks.en: Table 4.4 reports the proportion of harmful text generated by multimodal LLMs when conditioned on unsafe visual inputs. We evaluate ShieldCLIP as the visual encoder within the LLaVA architecture ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) , using the LLaMA-2-13B variant as the language backbone 6 6 6 We select this model because its visual encoder is compatible with ShieldCLIP trained for SD v1.4, based on CLIP ViT-L/14. The original LLaVA instead relies on CLIP ViT-L/14@336. . Generated captions are classified as harmful by combining two LLM-based classifiers ( i.e. , LLaMA-3.1-8B and GPT-3.5 Turbo), marking a caption unsafe if either classifier flags it.

blocks.en: In this setting, we compare ShieldCLIP against the standard LLaVA baseline, equipped with the original CLIP visual encoder, and two safety-aligned multimodal encoders: our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) and SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) . We evaluate 1,000 unsafe real images from each of three sources, covering sexual and nudity content ( i.e. , NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) and NSFW data source URLs) as well as broader unsafe visual cues ( i.e. , SMID ( Crone et al., 2018 ) ).
blocks.zh: 在此设定中,我们将ShieldCLIP与标准LLaVA基线进行比较,该基线配备了最初的CLIP视觉编码器,以及两个安全相联的多式联运编码器:我们之前的Safe-CLIP(Poppi等人,2024年)和SafeR-CLIP(Yousaf等人,2026a年). 我们评价了来自三个来源的1000幅不安全真实图像,涵盖性和裸体内容(即NudeNet(Bedapudi,2019年)和NSFW数据源URL)以及更广泛的不安全视觉提示(即SMID(Crone等人,2018年)).

blocks.en: Across all data sources, replacing the original visual encoder with ShieldCLIP substantially reduces harmful caption generation. On NudeNet and NSFW URLs, ShieldCLIP achieves the lowest harmful rates of 12.5% and 6.2%, improving over Safe-CLIP (14.6% and 7.5%) and SafeR-CLIP (17.4% and 10.2%). On SMID, all safety-aligned encoders perform similarly, with SafeR-CLIP obtaining the lowest rate (2.2%) and ShieldCLIP remaining close at 2.5%. Overall, these results show that the gains of ShieldCLIP extend beyond text-to-image generation to the image-to-text setting.
blocks.zh: 在所有数据源中,用ShieldCLIP替换原始的视觉编码器会大大减少有害标题生成. 在NudeNet和NSFW URL上,ShieldCLIP的有害率最低,分别为12.5%和6.2%,高于Safe-CLIP(14.6%和7.5%)和SafeR-CLIP(17.4%和10.2%)。 在SMID上,所有安全耦合编码器的性能都相似,SafeR-CLIP的速率最低(2.2%),ShieldCLIP的速率仍然接近2.5%. 总体而言,这些结果显示,ShieldCLIP的收益从文字到图像生成延伸到图像到文字设置.

blocks.en: The qualitative examples in Fig. 6 further illustrate this behavior: ShieldCLIP suppresses explicit visual cues that lead the original LLaVA, and in some cases Safe-CLIP, to produce unsafe descriptions, while retaining the coarse semantic context depicted in the input image.
blocks.zh: 图6中的定性例子进一步说明了这种行为:ShieldCLIP压制了引导原LLaVA的显性视觉提示,在某些情况下Safe-CLIP生成不安全的描述,同时保留了输入图像中所描绘的粗糙语义上下文.

blocks.en: 4.5 Image-Text Retrieval Results
blocks.zh: 4.5 图像文本检索结果

blocks.en: After assessing the harmful-content mitigation performance of ShieldCLIP when employed as either textual or visual encoders in multimodal generative pipelines, we next evaluate whether the aligned embedding space also improves safety in cross-modal retrieval. Table 4.5 compares ShieldCLIP with our previous Safe-CLIP formulation ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , HySAC ( Poppi et al., 2025 ) , a hyperbolic safety-aware CLIP variant, and SafeR-CLIP ( Yousaf et al., 2026a ) , always including the base CLIP model as reference.
blocks.zh: 在评估了ShieldCLIP在多式联运基因管道中用作文字编码或视觉编码时的有害内容缓减性能之后,我们接下来评估了对齐嵌入空间是否也提高了跨模式检索的安全性。 表4.5 将ShieldCLIP与我们以前的Safe-CLIP配方(Poppi等人,2024年),HySAC(Poppi等人,2025年),一种双曲安全意识的CLIP变体,以及SafeR-CLIP(Yousaf等人,2026年a年)相比较,始终将基础CLIP模型作为参考.

blocks.en: We evaluate both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) retrieval on ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , ViSUv2, and the three unsafe image sources used before ( i.e. , NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) , NSFW URLs, and SMID ( Crone et al., 2018 ) ), following the evaluation protocol defined in prior works ( Poppi et al., 2024 ; Poppi et al., 2025 ) . In both directions, an unsafe query retrieves from a mixed pool of safe and unsafe candidates, and we report the fraction of queries whose top-1 result is harmful. For ViSU and ViSUv2, we use their paired test splits; for ViSUv2, queries are restricted to samples where both generated modalities are unsafe. For the three image-only sources, we combine 1,000 unsafe images from each dataset with safe distractors from LAION-400M ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , using unsafe ViSUv2 captions as T2I queries and the unsafe images themselves as I2T queries.
blocks.zh: 我们在VisU(Poppi等人,2024年),Visuv2上评价了文本对图像(T2I)和图像对文本(I2T)的检索,以及之前使用的三个不安全图像来源(即NudeNet(Bedapudi,2019年),NSFW URLs,以及SMID(Crone等人,2018年),此前作品中定义的评价协议(Poppi等人,2024年;Poppi等人,2025年). 在两个方向上,一个不安全的查询从一个安全而不安全的混合候选人库中检索,我们报告一个最有害的查询的一小部分。 对于ViSU和ViSUv2,我们使用他们的配对测试分裂;对于ViSUv2,查询仅限于两种生成模式都不安全的样本. 对于三个只图像来源,我们把每个数据集的1000个不安全图像与LAION-400M(Shuhmann等人,2022年)的安全分流器结合起来,使用不安全的Visuv2标题作为T2I查询,不安全图像本身作为I2T查询.

blocks.en: Across benchmarks, ShieldCLIP strongly reduces harmful retrievals in both directions. In T2I retrieval, the harmful rate drops from 95.2% to 3.5% on ViSUv2 and from 90.9% to 14.4% on ViSU, substantially improving over Safe-CLIP (62.9% and 51.4%), HySAC (32.1% and 18.7%), and SafeR-CLIP (21.0% and 37.1%). On NudeNet, NSFW URLs, and SMID, ShieldCLIP remains below 0.5%, closely matching the best SafeR-CLIP results. In I2T retrieval, ShieldCLIP achieves 20.8% on ViSUv2 and 22.6% on ViSU, while reducing harmful retrievals on the three real-image sources to 0.0%, 0.1%, and 0.4%, respectively. Notably, SafeR-CLIP exhibits a marked directional imbalance on these datasets, increasing to 70.3%, 53.0%, and 52.7% in I2T despite near-zero T2I rates. In contrast, ShieldCLIP maintains consistently low harmful retrieval across both directions, indicating a more balanced safety alignment of the shared embedding space.
blocks.zh: 在整个基准中,ShieldCLIP在两个方向都大大减少了有害的检索。 在T2I检索中,ViSUv2的有害率从95.2%下降到3.5%,ViSU的有害率从90.9%下降到14.4%,比Safe-CLIP(62.9%和51.4%)、HySAC(32.1%和18.7%)和SafeR-CLIP(21.0%和37.1%)大有改善。 在NudeNet上,NSFW URLs和SMID上,ShieldCLIP仍然低于0.5%,与最佳的SafeR-CLIP结果紧密匹配. 在I2T检索中,ShieldCLIP在ViSUv2上达到20.8%,在ViSU上达到22.6%,同时将三个真象源的有害检索分别减少到0.0,0.1%和0.4%. 值得注意的是,SafeR-CLIP在这些数据集上显示出明显的方向不平衡,在I2T中上升至70.3%,53.0%和52.7%,尽管T2I率接近零。 相比之下,ShieldCLIP在两个方向上始终保持低度的有害检索,表明共享嵌入空间的安全性更加平衡。

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.6 阅读研究

blocks.en: Data vs. Selective Objective. We first disentangle the contribution of the training data from that of the selective alignment objective. To obtain a matched comparison with our previous Safe-CLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , we train both methods on ViSU and ViSUv2. When training ShieldCLIP on ViSU, we derive modality-specific safety labels using the same labeling pipeline adopted for ViSUv2; conversely, when training Safe-CLIP on ViSUv2, we discard these labels and treat all generated samples as unsafe, following its original formulation.
blocks.zh: 数据对选择目标。 我们首先将培训数据与选择性调整目标区分开来。 为了与我们先前的安全-CLIP(Poppi等人,2024年)进行比较,我们在Visu和Visuv2上对两种方法进行培训。 在VISU上训练ShieldCLIP时,我们使用为VISUv2采用的同一标签管道得出特定模式的安全标签;反之,在VISUv2上训练Safe-CLIP时,我们放弃这些标签,按照原始配方将所有生成的样品视为不安全。

blocks.en: Table 4.5 shows that both factors contribute to the final performance. Replacing ViSU with ViSUv2 substantially improves Safe-CLIP in several settings, confirming the benefit of the broader training data. More importantly, when the training data are fixed, ShieldCLIP consistently improves T2I retrieval and generation, with particularly large gains on I2P and in cross-dataset retrieval. The only exception is in-domain I2T retrieval on ViSUv2, where Safe-CLIP reaches 15.2% compared with 20.8% for ShieldCLIP; however, the same model transfers poorly to ViSU (59.9% versus 22.6%). These results indicate that the gains of ShieldCLIP cannot be attributed to ViSUv2 alone: modality-aware supervision provides complementary improvements, especially for T2I retrieval, generation, and cross-dataset robustness.
blocks.zh: 表4.5显示,这两个因素都有助于最终业绩。 用Visuv2取代Visu,大大改善了若干情况下的安全-CLIP,证实了更广泛的培训数据的好处。 更重要的是,当训练数据固定后,ShieldCLIP不断改进T2I的检索和生成,在I2P和跨数据集检索方面特别大的进展. 唯一的例外是在ViSUv2上的内域I2T检索,Safe-CLIP达到15.2%,而ShieldCLIP为20.8%;然而,同一型号向ViSU的传输不佳(59.9%对22.6%). 这些结果表明,ShieldCLIP的增益不能单归因于Visuv2:模式意识监督提供了互补的改进,特别是在T2I检索、生成和跨数据集稳健性方面。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ShieldCLIP, a selective safety-alignment framework for multimodal encoders, together with ViSUv2, a 195k-quadruplet dataset with independent safety labels for generated text and images. By conditioning preservation and redirection on the observed safety state of each modality, ShieldCLIP preserves benign content, redirects only unsafe representations, and explicitly handles mixed and jointly unsafe pairs. Across cross-modal retrieval, text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion v1.4 and SDXL, and image-to-text generation with LLaVA, ShieldCLIP consistently reduces harmful outputs compared with prior safety-aligned encoders and strong mitigation baselines while preserving the utility of the original embedding space. Targeted ablation studies further disentangle the contribution of ViSUv2 from that of the selective objective and confirm the importance of modality-specific supervision, dedicated treatment of mixed pairs, and the proposed loss formulation. The observed gains remain consistent across different prompt distributions and safety classifiers, while human judgments further support the safety and content-preservation properties of the resulting outputs. Overall, these results show that treating safety at the modality level provides a more effective and balanced alternative to uniformly redirecting generated content.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ShieldCLIP,这是多式联运编码器的选择性安全调节框架,与Visuv2一起引入了195k-qudruplet数据集,为生成的文本和图像设置了独立的安全标签. ShieldCLIP通过在每种模式的观测安全状态上设定保存条件和重定向,保留良性内容,只调整不安全的表示,并明确处理混合和共同不安全的对. 通过跨模式检索,以稳定扩散 v1.4 和 SDXL 生成文本到图像生成,以及以 LLaVA 生成图像到文本,与先前的安全编码器和强大的缓解基线相比,ShieldCLIP在保持原始嵌入空间的效用的同时,持续减少有害输出. 有针对性地进行疏解研究,进一步将VisUv2与选择性目标的作用区分开来,并确认了特定模式监督,对混合配对的专用处理以及拟议损失配方的重要性. 所观察到的收益在不同的迅速分发和安全分类器之间仍然一致,而人的判断进一步支持由此产生的产出的安全和内容保护特性。 总体而言,这些结果表明,在模式一级处理安全问题为统一调整生成的内容提供了更有效和更平衡的替代办法。

blocks.en: Our dataset construction begins by taking the safe captions from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and Flickr30k ( Young et al., 2014 ) and generating corresponding unsafe versions. To do this, we prompt LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) to rephrase each safe caption into an NSFW-themed one. The prompt includes an example reformulation and instructs the model to generate a caption that (i) is NSFW, (ii) remains a coherent and realistically plausible scene description, and (iii) incorporates a concept derived from the CoPro ( Liu et al., 2024b ) taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集构建首先从COCO(Lin等人,2014年)和Flickr30k(Young等人,2014年)获取安全字幕,并生成相应的不安全版本. 为此,我们请LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instructionct(Grattafiori等人,2024年)将每个安全标题重写成NSFW主题标题。 该示意图包括一个实例重写,并指示模型生成一个标题,即(一) NSFW,(二) 仍是一个连贯和现实可行的场景描述,以及(三) 包含一个源自CoPro(Liu等人,2024b)分类学的概念。

blocks.en: For each safe caption, we first identify the 50 tags (out of the 578 provided in ( Liu et al., 2024b ) ) whose CLIP embeddings are most similar to those of the input. We then randomly sample one tag from this 50-tag subset to guide the generation, ensuring that all CoPro concepts are sufficiently represented across the dataset. This selection step is crucial: by restricting the sampled concepts to those semantically close to the input caption, we avoid injecting irrelevant content that could lead to incoherent or meaningless reformulations. The prompt we use is shown in Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个安全标题,我们首先确定50个标记(在(Liu等人,2024b)提供的578个标记中),其CLIP嵌入最类似于输入的标记. 然后我们随机从这个50 tag 子集中抽取一个标记来引导生成,确保所有 CoPro 概念在数据集中得到充分的体现. 这一选择步骤至关重要:通过将抽样概念限制在那些与输入标题相近的地方,我们避免注入可能导致不一致或毫无意义的重写内容。 我们使用的提示在图8中显示.

blocks.en: We employ a controlled output prefilling strategy ( Cappelletti et al., 2026 ) to ensure that the model consistently follows the intended generation behavior without triggering refusal mechanisms. Prefilling works by introducing a short text fragment that initiates the response, so that the model interprets the subsequent decoding as a continuation of an already-started answer. In practice, the text fragment is inserted immediately after the model assistant-start token, making it the first element of the output sequence. The prefix used in our experiments is:
blocks.zh: 我们采用可控输出预填策略(Cappelletti等人,2026年),以确保模型始终遵循预期的生成行为,而不触发拒绝机制. 预补工作通过引入一个启动响应的短文本片段来进行,使模型将后续的解码解释为已经启动的答案的延续. 在实践中,文本片段紧接在模型助手启动符后插入,使其成为输出序列的第一个元素. 我们实验中使用的前缀是:

blocks.en: ‘‘Sure, the NSFW phrase is:’’ This prefix does not introduce any semantic information; it simply initiates the response so that the model proceeds with the requested caption transformation.
blocks.zh: 当然,NSFW短语是: 此前缀不会引入任何语义信息;它只是启动响应,使模型随请求的标题转换而进行.

blocks.en: Image Generator Selection. As illustrated in Fig. 2 of the main paper, we use two complementary diffusion models for image generation: a fine-tuned Stable Diffusion XL ( Podell et al., 2024 ) model and an uncensored FLUX variant ( Black Forest Labs, 2024 ) . We use LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct as a model selector to determine which generator is used for each caption. This choice is motivated by the observation that SDXL-based models often struggle to accurately render masculine nudity. We therefore classify whether the caption implies such content; if so, the image is generated with FLUX, and otherwise with SDXL. The prompt used for this selection is shown in Fig. 10 .
blocks.zh: 图像生成器选择 。 如主要论文图2所示,我们在图像生成方面使用了两个互补的传播模型:一个微调的稳定扩散XL(Podel等人,2024年)模型和一个未经审查的FLUX变体(黑森林实验室,2024年)。 我们使用LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct作为模型选择器来确定每个标题使用的生成器. 这种选择的动机是,有人观察到基于SDXL的模型往往难以准确地使男性裸体化. 因此,我们对标题是否包含此类内容进行分类;如果是的话,图像是用FLUX生成的,或者用SDXL生成的。 此选择所用的提示以图 10 显示 。

blocks.en:
Image Safety Labeling. To assign the final safety label f i v f^{v}_{i} to the selected generated images, we utilize an ensemble of two discriminative models: NudeNet ( Bedapudi, 2019 ) and Q16 ( Schramowski et al., 2022 ) . This combination ensures coverage of both explicit nudity and broader unsafe concepts ( e.g. , violence, hate). We adopt a union-based detection protocol: an image is labeled as unsafe ( f i v = 1 f^{v}_{i}=1 ) if either NudeNet or Q16 flags it. Conversely, an image is labeled as safe ( f i v = 0 f^{v}_{i}=0 ) only when both classifiers predict that the content is benign. This rigorous filtering ensures that the “generated-safe” subset of our ViSUv2 dataset contains high-confidence safe samples, minimizing contamination of the safe embedding space during alignment.
After completing both the text and image safety labeling stages, each generated pair in ViSUv2 is associated with independent modality labels f i t f_{i}^{t} and f i v f_{i}^{v} . This results in four possible configurations depending on whether the generated caption and image are classified as safe or unsafe.

blocks.en: 6.3 Human Validation of Modality-Level Safety Labels
blocks.zh: 6.3 人类验证方法-安全等级标签

blocks.en: To assess the reliability of the automated modality-level annotations used to train ShieldCLIP, we conduct a human validation study on 1,000 generated image-text pairs from ViSUv2. The evaluation set is sampled uniformly across the four modality-level safety configurations ( 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} , 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , 𝐓 s \mathbf{T}_{s} - 𝐕 u \mathbf{V}_{u} , and 𝐓 u \mathbf{T}_{u} - 𝐕 s \mathbf{V}_{s} ), while ensuring coverage of the harmful-content taxonomy. In total, 20 independent annotators participate in the study, with each sample evaluated by 3 annotators.
blocks.zh: 为了评估用于训练ShieldCLIP的自动模式级说明的可靠性,我们对从VISUv2生成的1000对图像文本进行人类验证研究. 该评价集在四种模式级安全配置(Ts\mathbf{T}_{s} - Vs\mathbf{V}_{s}, Tu\mathbf{T}_{u} - Vu\mathbf{V}_{u}, Ts\mathbf{V}_{u} , Ts\mathbf{V}_{s} 和 Tu\mathb{T}_{u} 中统一取样,同时确保有害内容分类学的覆盖. 共有20名独立的注释员参与研究,每个样本由3名注释员评估.

blocks.en: Annotators assess text and image safety independently. For each generated caption, they are asked to determine whether the text contains harmful or inappropriate content; the same binary judgment is collected separately for the corresponding generated image. The final human label for each modality is obtained by majority vote.
blocks.zh: 注释者独立评估文本和图像安全. 对于每个生成的字幕,请它们确定文本中是否包含有害或不适当的内容;对于相应的生成图像,同一二进制判断被单独收集. 每种方式的最终人类标签都是以多数票获得的.

blocks.en: We compare these human annotations with the automatic labels used during dataset construction. Agreement is computed between the automatic label and the aggregated human judgment for each modality. Overall, as reported in the main paper, the automatic annotations agree with human judgments on 86% of captions and 81% of images, supporting the reliability of our modality-level labeling strategy.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些人类说明与数据集构建过程中使用的自动标签进行比较. 每种方式的自动标签和人类总判断之间的一致是计算出来的。 总体来说,如主要论文所述,自动说明与人类对86%的字幕和81%的图像的判断一致,支持我们模式级标签策略的可靠性.

blocks.zh: 6.5 其他数据集实例

blocks.en: To qualitatively validate the diversity and semantic consistency of ViSUv2, Fig. 12 presents a series of multimodal quadruplets. Each sample anchors the generation process with a real, safe text-image pair (indicated by green borders) and juxtaposes it with a generated counterpart synthesized to manifest specific harmful concepts. We explicitly display the fine-grained tag used to condition the generation ( e.g. , “ terrorist ”, “ knives ”) alongside the high-level categories from our 28-class taxonomy ( e.g. , extremist ideologies , violence ) to which the tag belongs.
blocks.zh: 为了在质量上验证VISUv2的多样性和语义一致性,图12提出了一系列多式联运四重奏. 每个样本都用真实安全的文本图像对(以绿色边框表示)锁定生成过程,并用生成的对应物合成,以显示具体的有害概念。 我们明确显示用来为这一代人(例如“恐怖分子”、“刀子”)设置条件的精细标签,以及该标签所属的28级分类(例如极端主义意识形态、暴力)中的高级类别。

blocks.en: These examples highlight the necessity of our independent safety labeling strategy: unlike prior approaches that assume all generated content is harmful, our pipeline distinguishes between safe and unsafe samples for both text and images. This granularity captures the frequent asymmetry between modalities, where a prompt classified as unsafe may yield a visually benign image.
blocks.zh: 这些例子突出了我们独立的安全标签战略的必要性:与以往假设所有生成的内容都是有害的的做法不同,我们的管道区分了文本和图像的安全和不安全样本。 这种颗粒性能够捕捉模式之间经常出现的不对称现象,在模式中,被归类为不安全的瞬间可能会产生视觉上无害的图像.

blocks.en: For instance, the injection of the tag “ dumb ” into a caption about a baseball player results in a generated text describing “ perverted players ” yet the corresponding generated image remains a safe, standard depiction of the sport. Conversely, the conditioning tag “ savage ” produced the safe caption “ A savage devours the contents of the fridge ”, while the resulting image violates safety policies. By correctly identifying such mixed cases, alongside fully safe generated pairs and explicitly harmful ones, ViSUv2 enables a selective alignment process that mitigates actual risks without distorting safe regions of the embedding space.
blocks.zh: 例如,将标签“哑巴”注入关于棒球运动员的字幕中,结果产生了描述“变态球员”的文字,而相应的图像仍然是对运动的一种安全、标准的描述。 反之,“野蛮人”的标记产生了“野蛮人吞噬冰箱内装物”的安全标题,而由此产生的图像违反了安全政策。 ViSUv2通过正确识别这种混合情况,连同完全安全的双胞胎和明显有害的双胞胎,使有选择的对齐过程能够减轻实际风险,同时又不扭曲嵌入空间的安全区域。

blocks.en: Table 6 provides the category-level breakdown of the ViSU ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) results summarized in the main paper (cf. Table 4.3 ). We evaluate Stable Diffusion v1.4 using the same NudeNet-Q16 ensemble adopted in Section 4.3 , reporting harmful generation rates over the seven grouped harmful-content categories.

blocks.en: Beyond the overall average, ShieldCLIP exhibits a particularly uniform reduction in harmful generation rates across categories. It achieves the lowest harmful rate for violence (1.1%), self-harm (1.5%), shocking content (1.0%), and illegal activities (1.2%), reducing the corresponding SD v1.4 baseline rates of 31.3%, 19.9%, 29.9%, and 23.5%. On the remaining categories, the best results are obtained by DES ( Ahn and Jung, 2025 ) for hate (1.2%) and sexual content (0.7%), and by SafetyDPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) for harassment (1.1%). However, ShieldCLIP remains within 0.2–0.3 percentage points of these category-specific minima. As a result, its harmful generation rate remains confined to a narrow 1.0–1.5% range across all seven categories, compared with larger variations for DES (0.7–3.8%) and SafetyDPO (1.1–4.0%). This category-level consistency complements the aggregate results in the main paper, showing that the gains of selective alignment are distributed across heterogeneous harmful concepts rather than being driven by a small subset of categories.
blocks.zh: 超过总体平均水平,ShieldCLIP显示出各类有害生成率的下降尤为一致。 它在暴力(1.1%)、自残(1.5%)、令人震惊的内容(1.0%)和非法活动(1.2%)方面达到最低的有害率,使相应的SD v1.4基线率降低到31.3%、19.9%、29.9%和23.5%。 关于其余类别,最好的结果是DES(Ahn and Jung,2025年)的仇恨(1.2%)和性内容(0.7%),以及SafeDPO(Liu等人,2025年)的骚扰(1.1%)。 然而,ShieldCLIP仍然在这些类别特定微米的0.2-0.3个百分点以内。 因此,在所有7个类别中,其有害的生成率仍然限制在1.0%-1.5%的狭窄范围内,而DES(0.7-3.8%)和SafetyDPO(1.1-4.0%)则存在较大差异。 这种类别层面的一致性补充了主要文件中的汇总结果,表明选择性调整的收益分布在各种有害概念之间,而不是由一小部分类别驱动。

blocks.en: 8.2 Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 8.2 其他定性结果

blocks.en: This section presents additional qualitative results across downstream tasks. Fig. 14 extends the text-to-image evaluation shown in Fig. 5 with additional unsafe prompts, comparing ShieldCLIP with competing safety methods. The examples show that ShieldCLIP more consistently suppresses harmful visual cues while preserving the main scene semantics. Similarly, Fig. 15 complements the image-to-text examples shown in Fig. 6 with additional real NSFW images, showing that ShieldCLIP reduces explicit caption content while retaining the coarse context of the input.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍下游任务的其他质量成果。 图14将图5所示的文字到图像评价扩展至额外的不安全提示,将ShieldCLIP与相互竞争的安全方法进行比较. 例子显示,ShieldCLIP在保留主要场景语义的同时,更一致地压制有害的视觉提示. 同样,图15补充了图6中显示的图像对文字的例子,增加了真实的NSFW图像,表明ShieldCLIP在保留输入粗糙上下文的同时会减少清晰的字幕内容.

blocks.en: Despite the strong safety performance observed in the previous examples, some challenging cases remain. Fig. 16 presents representative failure cases where harmful visual elements are only partially suppressed or where the generation still reflects unsafe concepts from the prompt. These examples typically arise when the unsafe semantics are strongly entangled with the core scene description or when the generative backbone exhibits strong prior associations with certain harmful concepts. Nevertheless, even in these cases, the outputs often exhibit partial mitigation, indicating that the alignment can still attenuate unsafe visual associations under challenging conditions.
blocks.zh: 尽管前几个例子显示安全表现良好,但仍有一些具有挑战性的案件。 图16介绍了具有代表性的失败案例,其中有害的视觉元素仅被部分压制,或者一代人仍然从瞬间反应出不安全的概念. 这些例子通常出现在不安全的语义与核心场景描述紧密纠缠,或者当基因骨干表现出具有某些有害概念的强烈前缘关系时. 尽管如此,即使在这些情况中,产出也往往显示出部分的缓解,表明在挑战性条件下,调整仍然可以减轻不安全的视觉联系。

blocks.en: 9 Societal Impact and Limitations
blocks.zh: 9 社会影响和限制

blocks.en: 9.1 Ethical Implications
blocks.zh: 9.1 道德影响

blocks.en: ShieldCLIP is designed to mitigate harmful content in multimodal foundation models. While this approach improves the safety of text-to-image diffusion models and multimodal large language models in our evaluations, it also raises important ethical considerations. The construction of ViSUv2 required generating and handling explicit and potentially disturbing material, including sexual and violent content. These data were used solely for research on AI safety, and we do not plan to release the unsafe image subset without appropriate access controls.
blocks.zh: ShieldCLIP旨在减少多式联运基础模型中的有害内容。 虽然这种方法在我们的评价中改善了文本到图像传播模型和多式大型语言模型的安全性,但也提出了重要的道德考虑。 ViSUv2的建造需要生成和处理明确和可能令人不安的材料,包括性内容和暴力内容。 这些数据仅用于AI安全性的研究,我们不打算在没有适当访问控制的情况下释放不安全的图像子集.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the notion of harmfulness adopted in this work is derived from automated classifiers and large language models trained on web data. Consequently, it may reflect cultural and societal biases embedded in these sources, potentially marginalizing certain communities or perspectives. We acknowledge that “safety” is a context-dependent concept and that alignment decisions may not generalize across all cultural or linguistic domains. Thus, we consider ShieldCLIP a complementary step toward safer multimodal systems, rather than a definitive solution. Responsible deployment requires continuous monitoring, transparent reporting of failure cases, and inclusion of diverse ethical perspectives during model evaluation.
blocks.zh: 此外,在这项工作中采纳的有害性概念来自自动化分类器和接受过网络数据培训的大语言模型。 因此,它可能反映这些来源中蕴含的文化和社会偏见,可能使某些社区或观点边缘化。 我们承认,“安全”是一个取决于具体情况的概念,而协调决定可能不会在所有文化或语言领域通用。 因此,我们认为ShieldCLIP是朝着更安全的多式联运系统迈出的补充步骤,而不是一个最终的解决办法。 负责任的部署需要持续监测、透明地报告失败案件,并在模式评价中纳入不同的道德操守观点。

blocks.en: 9.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9.2 限制

blocks.en: While ShieldCLIP effectively suppresses harmful multimodal associations and preserves semantic fidelity across various benchmarks, some limitations remain. Our method does not provide absolute guarantees against unsafe generations or retrievals. It may fail in edge cases where harmfulness is ambiguous or where visual and textual cues interact in unanticipated ways. Additionally, the effectiveness of selective safety alignment depends on the accuracy and balance of the ViSUv2 labels; residual biases or annotation errors may propagate into the fine-tuned embedding space.
blocks.zh: 虽然ShieldCLIP有效地压制了有害的多式联运协会,并保持了不同基准的语义忠诚,但仍有一些局限性。 我们的方法不能提供绝对的保障,防止不安全的世代或回收。 在有害性模糊不清或视觉和文字提示以意料之外的方式相互作用的边缘情况下,可能失败。 此外,选择性安全调整的有效性取决于VISUv2标签的准确性和平衡性;剩余偏差或注释错误可能传播到微调的嵌入空间中。

blocks.en: Another limitation lies in the reliance on predefined taxonomies of harmful content, which cannot encompass all possible manifestations of risk or offense. Moreover, while ShieldCLIP improves safety for CLIP-like encoders, it may not fully transfer to downstream models with different architectures or decoding strategies. Future work should focus on expanding the diversity of safety concepts, exploring human-in-the-loop refinement, and developing adaptive alignment mechanisms that dynamically adjust to evolving definitions of harm and acceptability.
blocks.zh: 另一种限制是依赖预先界定的有害内容分类,这不能包括所有可能的危险或犯罪。 此外,虽然ShieldCLIP提高了类似CLIP编码器的安全性,但它可能没有完全转移到具有不同架构或解码策略的下游模型. 今后的工作应侧重于扩大安全概念的多样性,探索改进人与人之间的关系,并发展适应性调整机制,以动态地适应不断变化的危害和可接受性定义。
